page.layout: One printed page. Top: a woodcut ornament strip, then the centred title "INDEX PRIMVS, VBI ordine alphabetico haereses ab Augustino commemoratæ proponuntur." Below: one column of heresy names on the left, each with its chapter reference at the right. Letter "A." heads the first group and "B." the second, with a large woodcut "A" beside the first entries. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: INDEX PRIMVS, VBI ordine alphabetico haereses ab Augustino commemoratæ proponuntur.

page.notes: The large letter beside "Belonitæ" is a decorative woodcut initial A, not text. The faint ghosted lines at the top and through the page are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. The running head is not legible enough to transcribe with confidence. No page number or signature is printed. The final word "Bardesa-" is the start of the next entry, carried to the next page with its printed hyphen.
